title: ROB RUN Server Status: Outages & Waiting for Status Info
description: Check ROB RUN server announcements, recent connection issues and what to try when stuck on “waiting for status information.” Sources and timestamps included.

hero.eyebrow: ROB RUN practical guide · Reviewed Nov 11, 2026
hero.heading: ROB RUN Server Status & Connection Problems
hero.lead: Kefir confirmed DDoS-related connection drops and lag during launch week, and later reported improvement without saying the issue was fully resolved. This is historical developer information—not a claim about live server uptime. Check official announcements now before troubleshooting your PC.

sections.heading: ROB RUN Server Status: What Is Confirmed?
sections.intro: The ROB RUN server status question has two different meanings. An announcement can confirm that the developer was investigating an incident at the time it was posted; it cannot establish that every individual state server is healthy right now. This guide is an incident-reference and troubleshooting resource, not a live server monitor. For current information, follow the developer announcements linked below before deciding that your own connection is the problem.

subsections.heading: What a notice proves
paragraphs: Check the publication date and time before sharing an announcement as evidence. A report about DDoS attempts or maintenance proves an issue was acknowledged at that moment; it does not prove a present global outage.
If the latest official notice has not changed, label it as the latest notice rather than automatically assigning an Online or Offline status. This site does not operate a live endpoint probe.

sections.heading: Waiting for Status Information: What to Check
sections.intro: If ROB RUN stalls on waiting for status information, first record the exact wording and when the message appears. Check whether Steam has a pending download or game update. Then read the latest official announcement, close and reopen the client, and check your own network connection. If the developer has acknowledged widespread service disruption, repeated local reinstall attempts may not solve a server-side problem. These are diagnostic checks, not guaranteed fixes.

subsections.heading: Check the exact startup symptom
paragraphs: Record whether the client freezes before sign-in, displays waiting for status information, or disconnects after joining a state; these are different troubleshooting branches.

Check Steam downloads, restart the game and Steam once, and compare your result with Kefir’s current troubleshooting notes. Avoid reinstalling repeatedly while an active widespread issue is acknowledged.

sections.heading: Is ROB RUN Down, or Is It Just My Server?
sections.intro: When reporting a connection problem, include the time and timezone, EU or East US region if known, the state/server involved, and the precise message on screen. If it is safe, include a screenshot with account details obscured. Never publish account passwords, Steam authentication codes, payment information or private identifiers to a public discussion. State whether the problem is reproducible after a restart.

subsections.heading: Compare several signals
paragraphs: Ask whether friends in the same state and region have the same error. One failing state does not demonstrate that the entire game is offline, and a large Steam player total does not prove your specific state is reachable.
Report the exact UTC time, the region selected, the client version and the message shown. Never include your credentials or session tokens in a public screenshot.

sections.heading: Server Regions and Fresh Server Notices
sections.intro: A region, a new state, and a single client session are different scopes. A global Steam player-count number does not tell you whether the specific state you selected can accept connections. If other friends are unaffected, compare game versions, region and state before assuming a global outage. Avoid changing server merely to bypass an issue until you have read the consequences in our switching guide.

subsections.heading: Region versus state
paragraphs: Kefir has referred to EU and East US server regions. Treat a region, a fresh state and an individual session as different levels; do not mistake one for another.
Consult the change-server guide before using a surrender-based move to escape connection errors. A server move may carry gameplay consequences unrelated to the original outage.

sections.heading: Known Incidents and Developer Updates
sections.intro: During launch week, developer/community notices discussed DDoS-related instability, lag and connection errors. Those reports establish that the issue was real then, not that servers are currently down. This page was reviewed on November 11, 2026; its date should not be interpreted as a continuously updated heartbeat. Use developer announcements for the most recent authoritative statement.

subsections.heading: Read incident dates
paragraphs: Use the date of the developer post, not this article’s review date, when referring to launch-week connection attacks or lag. A later message may supersede an earlier report.
Do not convert the absence of a new notice into a guarantee that all states are healthy. Check the current announcement stream and in-game notices before drawing a conclusion.

sections.heading: What to Include in a Bug Report
sections.intro: This guide is a dated summary of the verified primary sources. Confirm all changing game rules against official help and announcements before acting. Specific destinations, times and mechanics can be different after game updates; we do not present an unverified claim as established fact.

subsections.heading: Prepare a useful support report
paragraphs: Provide the in-game error text, whether the issue began before or after loading a state, your approximate UTC timestamp, and what changed after a client restart.
Attach an image only after hiding personal identifiers. Kefir’s support instructions invite a description of the events before the issue and an image or video when appropriate.

sections.heading: A five-minute connection check
paragraphs: Check Steam downloads before changing any game setting. Read the newest developer announcement and compare its timestamp to your own error. Note whether the client reaches a character or state selection screen, or stops earlier while requesting status information. Restart the game once after completing a pending update. If the official notice mentions regional disruption, it is sensible to avoid repeated destructive local changes until the issue is resolved.

sections.heading: What this guide cannot tell you
paragraphs: A Steam player total, a server list screenshot and a message posted earlier in the week are not measurements of the exact server you need today. This site has no authenticated game-server telemetry integration. We will not display a green ONLINE badge or a fabricated last-updated counter. If you need current availability, click the linked official developer announcements and inspect their dates.

title: How to Change Server in ROB RUN and Join Friends
description: Change servers in ROB RUN using the official Prison and Surrender to Feds route. Follow the steps, resend your invite and review what to check before moving.

hero.eyebrow: ROB RUN practical guide · Reviewed Nov 11, 2026
hero.heading: How to Change Server in ROB RUN
hero.lead: Kefir’s official help route: open the global map, select Prison and choose “Surrender to Feds”; once in prison, change to your friend’s server, then resend the party invite. Before surrendering, check what you may lose.

sections.heading: How to Change Server in ROB RUN: Official Steps
sections.intro: According to Kefir support, when a party invitation says your friend is on another server, open the global map, locate Prison, choose Surrender to Feds and use the server-change option while in prison. Once you have selected your friend’s destination, send a new party invitation. The exact appearance of menus can change between game versions; follow the names shown in your current client rather than an unverified screenshot.

subsections.heading: The published route
paragraphs: Kefir’s support instructions describe opening the global map, selecting the Prison and choosing Surrender to Feds. The character can then select the destination state inside the Prison flow.

Check the current in-game confirmation screens before taking the action. Names and consequences may change during Early Access; this article is not a substitute for the warning shown to your character.

sections.heading: Join a Friend on Another Server
sections.intro: Surrender is an in-game action and can affect your situation. Do not treat it as a risk-free region selector. Before proceeding, inspect in-game warnings and any current official rules on held items, buildings and team progress. Kefir’s invitation troubleshooting note provides the route but does not list every possible property or inventory consequence; this guide deliberately avoids inventing a guaranteed retention list.

subsections.heading: Match a friend’s state
paragraphs: Ask your friend for the exact region and state they are on; a similar state label does not guarantee you have selected the same destination.

Use the official in-game party or invitation flow after joining the destination. If the invitation still says different servers, compare both players’ state and region rather than repeatedly clicking join.

sections.heading: What You May Lose When Switching
sections.intro: A region is the broader geographic service area, while a state/server is the shared world your character enters. Two players may be in the same broad region but not the same state, so their invitation may still fail. Confirm the destination with the friend who is already inside before surrendering. A newly opened state is not the same thing as changing an existing state’s wipe schedule.

subsections.heading: Progress may be affected
paragraphs: Do not assume that every item, base, plot or resource transfers when switching states. The surrender screen and the current support article should be treated as the authority.
Before committing, review what matters to you: shared housing, cash, equipment, friends, and your current state’s progression. Avoid promises that a particular asset is always retained.

sections.heading: Changing Region vs Changing State
sections.intro: If the invite still fails, compare both players’ selected state and game versions, then retry the invitation instead of endlessly repeating the surrender procedure. Check the latest official support and service announcements if the problem began during maintenance. If the option is missing, capture the client version and menu where you expected it; do not assume an old guide describes the current interface.

subsections.heading: Know the scope
paragraphs: Switching a state inside the game is not the same as selecting an EU or East US region. If the region you need is absent, do not invent a hidden toggle.
The server selector shown at your current build is the source of truth. Regional choices and capacity may change with patches.

inlineLinks.label: selecting an EU or East US region

sections.heading: Server Age and Fresh Starts
sections.intro: Do not look for a Roblox-style game server list: ROB RUN is a separate Steam title. Do not assume simply leaving a party transfers a character to another state. Do not tell friends that switching preserves all property until you have confirmed the current warning. Refer to official game support for changes to the surrender process.

subsections.heading: New states are not wipes
paragraphs: A freshly opened state may have a different age or economy than the one your friend occupies. That does not establish that the original state was reset.
Check the original state and its Federal Raid cycle separately. See our wipe guide for the difference between a planned reset and the launch of an additional state.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting Missing Prison or Server Options
sections.intro: This guide is a dated summary of the verified primary sources. Confirm all changing game rules against official help and announcements before acting. Specific destinations, times and mechanics can be different after game updates; we do not present an unverified claim as established fact.

subsections.heading: If the action is missing
paragraphs: Make sure the game loaded completely and inspect the current global map. Compare your screen to the support article rather than following an unverified shortcut.
If the Prison or surrender option is absent, capture the game build and screen state and consult current support guidance; do not recommend deleting local game files as a server-switch method.

sections.heading: Before pressing Surrender to Feds
paragraphs: Confirm the exact state your friend is using and whether a new invitation is required. Tell your party members you are about to change state, then read the warning shown by your game client. Make sure you are not relying on an unverified assumption that inventory, land and money will travel with you. The official help describes how to resolve a friend mismatch, not an exhaustive guarantee for every item.

sections.heading: If you cannot find Prison
paragraphs: Use the global map search and location cues in your current version of ROB RUN. The official procedure names Prison and Surrender to Feds; a stale guide image could show a different map arrangement. If the map itself will not load, solve the connection problem before making repeated attempts. Keep the game version and any error text ready if you contact support.

title: ROB RUN Wipe Schedule: 7-Day Federal Raid & Resets
description: ROB RUN wipes follow a seven-day Federal Raid cycle. See what is reset, what carries over and how to check your own server’s next reset without fake countdowns.

hero.eyebrow: ROB RUN practical guide · Reviewed Nov 11, 2026
hero.heading: ROB RUN Wipe Schedule and Reset Rules
hero.lead: Kefir says each server has a seven-day Federal Raid cycle: plots, bases, weapons and cash reset and convert into jail time and authority. Cosmetics, your name, tutorial progress, settings and accumulated jail time carry over.

sections.heading: How Often Does ROB RUN Wipe?
sections.intro: Kefir describes a recurring Federal Raid wipe cycle for ROB RUN. The published help documentation discusses resets on a seven-day cadence, but a seven-day rule is not a guarantee that all state servers reset simultaneously at one worldwide clock time. Distinguish each state’s lifecycle from fresh server openings and maintenance events.

subsections.heading: Seven-day cycle, not one global time
paragraphs: Kefir describes a Federal Raid wipe cycle of approximately seven days for a state. A state-specific timer should be checked in the game rather than calculated from one sitewide launch timestamp.
Distinguish the normal progression reset from maintenance, a disconnection, a new state launch, or a planned server opening.

sections.heading: What Gets Wiped vs What Carries Over
sections.intro: The wipe can reset world progress, including land plots, bases, weapons and in-game cash according to official guidance. Whether a particular account-level entitlement or item carries over must be checked against the latest official article and current in-game wording. Avoid relying on old player-created infographics; this distinction matters when deciding whether to invest in a base shortly before a reset.

subsections.heading: Check item-by-item
paragraphs: Do not reduce the wipe question to everything resets or nothing resets. Inventory, buildings, bank balances, penalties and character identity may follow different rules.
Read the current in-game Federal Raid notice and Kefir Help Center. This guide does not assert that an item survives unless supported by those sources.

sections.heading: When Is the Next Wipe on My Server?
sections.intro: First establish the state you are playing on and its age, then check the most recent developer post or in-game notice for that specific state. Do not calculate a universal countdown from the November 4 Steam launch date. A simple seven-day arithmetic timer cannot prove the actual restart time after patch rescheduling, outages or newly opened servers.

subsections.heading: Find your state’s schedule
paragraphs: Identify your exact server or state and the countdown shown inside your current game build. A global average is not a valid next-wipe timer for every state.
If a community site shows a countdown, check its timezone, refresh mechanism and official evidence before treating it as authoritative.

sections.heading: Federal Raid: Money, Authority and Jail Time
sections.intro: Before your next session, learn which goals are tied to the current state versus your player account. If you need to move to a fresh state to play with friends, review the server change guide separately: joining another server and waiting for a scheduled raid are not interchangeable actions. Consider wrapping up short-term projects if the current state announces a wipe soon.

subsections.heading: A Federal Raid has distinct effects
paragraphs: The wipe is a game-world progression event, not the same as surrendering to switch a server. Do not confuse the two Prison-related concepts.
Read current notices for how cash, authority and jail time are handled. In particular, avoid broad guarantees that a bank action protects progress from Federal Raid effects.

sections.heading: Fresh Server vs Server Wipe
sections.intro: A scheduled Federal Raid is part of the game cycle. A rollback can occur when developers recover from an unexpected issue, and maintenance can temporarily interrupt service without triggering the full wipe rules. Do not interpret a developer incident notice as proof that a scheduled Federal Raid occurred. For service disruption, consult the server status guide and official updates.

subsections.heading: New worlds versus existing worlds
paragraphs: A new state opening can let a player choose a fresh start. That event does not prove that every currently active state was wiped at that hour.
If you are meeting friends, compare both state identities before deciding whether a new world is desirable. The switch-server guide covers the separate joining process.

sections.heading: Prepare for a Reset
sections.intro: This guide is a dated summary of the verified primary sources. Confirm all changing game rules against official help and announcements before acting. Specific destinations, times and mechanics can be different after game updates; we do not present an unverified claim as established fact.

subsections.heading: A practical pre-wipe checklist
paragraphs: Check the in-game countdown and capture the current rules for items or balances that matter to you. Coordinate with your group before moving or spending resources.
Do not rely on an unofficial universal schedule, and do not spend premium or limited resources on the assumption that an unverified item will be preserved.

sections.heading: Ask the right question about a specific item
paragraphs: When you ask whether something survives a wipe, specify whether it belongs to a world state, a base, personal inventory, bank account or longer-lived player identity. An item carried into a new state is a different question from an item surviving a scheduled Federal Raid on the same state. Rely on the current official rules rather than assuming all progress is protected or all progress is lost.

sections.heading: Why a universal wipe timer is misleading
paragraphs: Individual state ages, fresh state openings and changes announced by the developer can affect when you should expect a reset. Even if a regular seven-day cycle is documented, adding seven days to the game’s Steam release date will not identify every state’s next reset. Check the relevant state and current announcement before scheduling a raid, transfer or major base project.

title: Is ROB RUN on PS5 or Xbox? Console & PC Support
description: Is ROB RUN on PS5 or Xbox? Check the verified Steam platform listing, current Windows PC availability and whether Kefir has announced a console release.

hero.eyebrow: ROB RUN practical guide · Reviewed Nov 11, 2026
hero.heading: Is ROB RUN on Console, PS5 or Xbox?
hero.lead: As checked November 11, 2026, ROB RUN is officially available for Windows PC via Steam. The checked official store and announcements do not list an announced PS5 or Xbox release date. Absence of an announcement is not a promise the game will never come to console.

sections.heading: Is ROB RUN on PS5?
sections.intro: The official Steam store lists ROB RUN as a Windows PC title. As of this review, the cited official listing does not establish a PlayStation 5 or Xbox release. The safest current way to install the game is through Steam on a supported PC, not a third-party download page advertising a console or browser port.

subsections.heading: PS5 status at review
paragraphs: The verified Steam listing provides a Windows PC game and does not provide a PS5 storefront download. We did not locate an official PS5 launch announcement in the primary sources reviewed on November 11, 2026.
No official console release announcement found is not the same as a promise that a future PS5 version will never happen. Check the developer’s latest announcement channel.

sections.heading: Is ROB RUN on Xbox?
sections.intro: We did not find an official PS5 release announcement among the primary sources used for this guide. That is a status statement about currently verified sources, not a claim that a future PlayStation release is impossible. Before trusting a promised launch date, require a direct store listing or an announcement from Kefir.

subsections.heading: Xbox status at review
paragraphs: The available Steam product information identifies the PC edition; it does not establish a released Xbox Series X|S or Xbox One edition.
Treat websites advertising a ROB RUN Xbox installer as unverified unless a legitimate platform storefront or developer account confirms it.

sections.heading: Where Can You Play ROB RUN Today?
sections.intro: The same distinction applies to Xbox: no Xbox release is confirmed by the official Steam listing and available support resources reviewed here. Search results that reuse ROB RUN artwork or a generic “Xbox download” button are not evidence of a licensed console build. A valid Xbox release should have an official platform listing or verified developer announcement.

subsections.heading: Where to get the genuine game
paragraphs: Use the Steam App 4262460 listing for the verified Windows game. Check its system requirements, free-to-play price and developer name before installing.
This independent guide is not an online browser edition; its Play on Steam link must take you to the official product page, not to Roblox or an unrelated game.

sections.heading: ROB RUN Console Release Date: What Is Confirmed?
sections.intro: Windows PC support should not be confused with guaranteed Steam Deck, macOS, Linux or mobile compatibility. Third-party videos may demonstrate workarounds but are not official support commitments. Verify platform compatibility at the source and review the current game requirements before assuming that controller input or a handheld PC is supported.

subsections.heading: Release dates need primary evidence
paragraphs: A console-related rising search query signals interest, not a planned port. Do not transform an autocomplete suggestion into a claimed release date.
If Kefir announces a console version, confirm the platform, exact wording and date directly in official Steam news or the console storefront before changing this page.

sections.heading: Controller and Steam Deck Status

When a new console platform is formally announced, the platform table and this section should be updated with the exact official date and original source. Until then, the page intentionally does not provide a console release countdown, preorder URL or fabricated install instructions.

subsections.heading: Controller versus platform support
paragraphs: Controller input and Steam Deck compatibility are different questions from whether the game has a native console release. Do not infer a PS5 version from a PC controller test.
Check current Steam controller and Deck compatibility indicators. A personal workaround is not an official compatibility guarantee.

sections.heading: Official Download, Safety and Fake App Names
sections.intro: This guide is a dated summary of the verified primary sources. Confirm all changing game rules against official help and announcements before acting. Verify the publisher, platform and store domain. Do not enter Steam credentials into a random fan guide or download an executable supplied by an unrelated mirror.

sections.heading: How to verify future platform announcements
paragraphs: Use the developer’s official Steam announcements or a verified console storefront listing rather than third-party video thumbnails, fan mockups or search snippets. Check whether the announcement identifies ROB RUN by Kefir and a confirmed platform date. A promised PS5 controller layout or Xbox logo on an unofficial website is not enough to prove an actual downloadable console edition.

title: How to Open a Bank Account in ROB RUN: Steps & Cash
description: Learn how to open a ROB RUN bank account as a civilian, use the Laundering Desk to deposit dirty cash and withdraw funds from an ATM, with official sources.

hero.eyebrow: ROB RUN practical guide · Reviewed Nov 11, 2026
hero.heading: How to Open a Bank Account in ROB RUN
hero.lead: According to Kefir: visit Looty Bay Bank as a Civilian to open an account. To put dirty cash into your bank funds, use the Laundering Desk at your base and allow processing time. You can withdraw from an ATM; banked money remains protected from theft only until the next wipe.

sections.heading: How to Open a Bank Account in ROB RUN
sections.intro: Kefir’s ROB RUN help documentation describes opening an account as a civilian at Looty Bay Bank. Make sure you are following the in-game bank system rather than a real-world financial website. This page only explains game mechanics; it does not ask for any payment card, personal identity or external bank account.

subsections.heading: Opening an account
paragraphs: Kefir’s banking guidance places account opening at the bank in Looty Bay. Go to the bank and follow the available in-game account-opening interaction rather than expecting an account to appear automatically.
Use the current banking interface and any displayed requirements as the final authority. Do not assume every character can complete the same action regardless of role or current state.

sections.heading: How to Deposit Money in ROB RUN
sections.intro: Follow the game’s civilian banking flow at Looty Bay Bank as described in the official guide. If your game shows a different prerequisite or menu name after an update, treat the live client and latest Kefir documentation as the source of truth. We intentionally avoid inventing a fee, minimum balance, exact dialogue line or on-screen button that the primary source does not verify.

subsections.heading: Depositing is not laundering
paragraphs: Distinguish a normal bank deposit from turning illicit cash into spendable funds. The official help materials describe the bank and a Laundering Desk as separate interactions.
If money is not accepted by a bank interaction, check the type of currency and the current prompt. Do not claim a fixed exchange rate or processing fee without a verified current source.

sections.heading: How to Withdraw Cash at an ATM
sections.intro: ROB RUN distinguishes carried or illegal cash from banked money. The official guide explains using a Laundering Desk in your base for the relevant cash-processing step and using ATMs for withdrawals. Bank account opening, laundering, depositing and withdrawing are related tasks but not identical actions; confirm your money’s current category before attempting the wrong interaction.

subsections.heading: Withdrawing at an ATM
paragraphs: ATMs serve a different purpose from opening the account or processing cash. Verify the current location and available withdrawal action in the game interface.
Before assuming funds disappeared, check whether you are viewing the right balance and whether the transaction completed. Screens may change in Early Access.

sections.heading: Is Money Safe in the Bank?
sections.intro: Laundering is an in-game mechanic for processing cash before it can be used through the banking system as described by Kefir. The procedure should not be mistaken for real-life financial advice. Avoid unofficial claims of a fixed laundering speed or exchange rate, because these can be changed by patches and are not confirmed by the source used here.

subsections.heading: Do not promise wipe immunity
paragraphs: An amount shown in a bank UI is not evidence that it persists through every Federal Raid. Consult the published wipe rules and in-game confirmation before relying on bank storage as a safeguard.
Avoid making unsupported claims that banked, clean or dirty money always survives. See the wipe guide for the state-specific reset question.

sections.heading: Bank Account vs Dirty Cash vs Laundered Money
sections.intro: Opening a bank account does not automatically prove that every stored balance is protected from the Federal Raid wipe. Check the wipe rules for the current state before you assume cash will survive. For the seven-day cycle and the difference between state progress and account features, read the wipe guide linked below.

subsections.heading: Three separate money concepts
paragraphs: An account, clean bank balance and cash awaiting processing are not synonyms. Read the labels shown in the bank and Laundering Desk rather than assuming one action moves every money category.
Record the balance before and after a transaction if you are troubleshooting, but do not disclose private account details in a public bug report.

sections.heading: Common Banking Problems
sections.intro: This guide is a dated summary of the verified primary sources. Confirm all changing game rules against official help and announcements before acting. Specific destinations, times and mechanics can be different after game updates; we do not present an unverified claim as established fact.

subsections.heading: When the bank interaction fails
paragraphs: Check that you are at the correct place, have selected the intended interaction and have enough of the relevant funds. Read any restriction shown by the game.
If a button is unavailable, capture the exact prompt and your game version for support. Avoid proposing fake shortcuts, guaranteed workarounds or unverified deposit limits.

sections.heading: The three banking tasks are different
paragraphs: First establish that the account is opened at Looty Bay Bank while playing the required civilian role. Next identify whether your cash needs the base Laundering Desk process described by Kefir. Finally, when you need available banked funds in the world, use an ATM as instructed in the official help. Treat each task separately; doing one does not prove the other two have happened automatically.

sections.heading: Problems to double-check
paragraphs: If opening an account fails, verify your current role and whether you are at the correct bank in the current client. If money does not appear where expected, check whether it is held cash, waiting for an in-game process or already banked. Do not enter payment details into any external page claiming to repair a ROB RUN bank account. This is an in-game fictional economy, not a real financial institution.

sections.heading: Quick reference and decisions
sections.intro: These are practical starting points, not a live telemetry feed. Review original sources and in-game warnings before taking irreversible actions.

table.caption: ROB RUN: quick reference for bank account
rows: Visit Looty Bay Bank as civilian

paragraphs: Reviewed on November 11, 2026. This independent guide summarizes official sources at the time of writing. Server status, platform announcements, wipe timing and game interfaces may change. Consult the original sources directly for updates.

This is a fan-made guide, not an official service-status dashboard or an affiliated game download. Do not provide game credentials, personal information or payment details to unofficial links.

title: ROB RUN Patch Notes & Latest Updates (November 2026)
description: Read the November 17 ROB RUN patch notes for Jail Time limits, cross-region Battle Pass points, Shipments and voice chat. See the Steam update timeline.

hero.heading: ROB RUN Patch Notes and Updates
hero.lead: Kefir’s November 17, 2026 update added daily and overall Jail Time limits, made Battle Pass points carry over when you change regions, and improved connection stability. It also added Shipments to Lenny’s menu and temporarily took Eviction Rights out of barter.

source.label: Kefir’s November 17 patch notes on Steam

sections.heading: Latest ROB RUN patch notes for November 17

table.caption: November 17 patch at a glance
rows: Jail Time has new daily and overall limits. If you are working toward a Shipments unlock, check the item’s requirement and your current total.
Kefir says Battle Pass points carry over when you change regions. Compare your point total before and after a move.
Voice access in Prison and at Lenny’s Motel now depends on land ownership and accumulated Jail Time. Consider those conditions if voice works elsewhere.
You can open Shipments from Lenny’s context menu. Eviction Rights were temporarily removed from barter.
Mouse settings now support an inverted Y-axis. The death-screen Report button is easier to spot, and character names have a profanity filter.
Kefir reports stability improvements. For current connection problems, check the latest notice for your region.

sections.heading: How the November patch affects your next session

subsections.heading: Jail Time, Shipments and Battle Pass points
paragraphs: If you were accumulating years to unlock a specific Shipment, check the requirement for that item in the Shipments tab. The progress total and the item's unlock requirement answer different questions. Kefir announced daily and overall limits, while the exact values and reset hour remain unpublished. The Jail Time limits guide covers what to record if your total has stopped moving.

For players changing regions, the patch explicitly names Battle Pass points. Compare the same pass on the same Steam account before and after the change. If you are researching the move because a friend sent an invite, first check whether you need a different region or just their state. The region switching guide walks through both decisions.

subsections.heading: Lenny’s menu, barter and voice chat
paragraphs: Use Lenny’s context menu to reach Shipments. The menu entry helps you check unlock requirements where you interact with Lenny. For players looking at an older barter guide, the November notes describe Eviction Rights as temporarily removed from barter. The announcement gives no return date.

The voice restriction applies in Prison and at Lenny’s Motel. If a friend can hear you elsewhere, check whether the problem is limited to these locations and whether the affected player has a land plot and accumulated Jail Time. That information is more useful than repeatedly changing audio devices when only these locations are affected.

sections.heading: November 2026 update timeline

table.caption: Selected official Steam announcements, newest first
rows: Jail Time limits, cross-region Battle Pass points, voice access, UI and connection changes.
Kefir reported EU login and stability problems and later announced an upcoming restart.
Kefir discussed simpler server selection and a weapon repair feature as future work.
Tier 1 land rentals moved to a document cost. Police respawn delays increased, and patrol gear begins with pistols on fresh servers.

sections.intro: Dates below refer to official Steam posts. Use the type column to see which posts announced shipped changes, a service incident or future work.

subsections.heading: November 14 and 13: service notice and developer Q&A
paragraphs: The November 14 post concerned login trouble and instability on EU servers. Kefir said US servers were unaffected by that incident and later added a restart notice. If the symptoms sound familiar, check the date and region against any current announcement before using this post to explain today’s trouble.

The November 13 Q&A is useful when reading older guides about server selection and gear. Kefir acknowledged that the route through Prison was inconvenient and said it wanted to simplify server selection. It also described weapon repair as planned and said gear durability drops on death. Those answers describe intended work and the rules at the time of the Q&A.

subsections.heading: November 4: what actually shipped at launch
paragraphs: The launch-day changes made police respawn slower, with longer delays after consecutive deaths. Patrol officers started with pistols on fresh servers and received access to better gear as the server got older. The studio also lowered the basic pistol price and added starter weapon spawn points. Use those launch notes when comparing what shipped with what had been discussed during the playtest.

For the economy, the same post changed tier-one settlement and land rental costs to documents, increased base business returns and raised the value of dismantling or selling Shipments. It also made Shipments less frequent and slower to dismantle. These are the launch-day balance changes. The November 17 Shipments entry concerns how players open the menu at Lenny’s.

sections.heading: How to check an update in Steam and in game
paragraphs: Open ROB RUN in your Steam library and finish any pending download before comparing your client with these ROB RUN patch notes. Match the official post’s date to the change you are checking. If Steam shows a download with no matching notes, the download alone gives you no list of gameplay changes.

subsections.heading: Check one change at a time
paragraphs: Choose a check that fits your next session. If you are shopping for an unlock, look for the Shipments entry in Lenny’s menu. If you had trouble reporting from the death screen, look for the more visible Report control there. If you intend to try mouse inversion, note your original preference before testing the new option so you can restore it easily.

subsections.heading: Use the error code if you still cannot connect
paragraphs: Kefir’s support page tells players with E-0301 or E-0302 to close the game, restart Steam and update the client. E-0201 describes a connection that dropped after play had already started. For a region-wide issue, open the ROB RUN server status guide and check dated notices before you change regions or recommend a move to your party.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: ROB RUN error codes

faq.question: When did the latest verified patch come out?
faq.answer: Kefir published the patch notes on November 17, 2026 at 11:19 UTC. Its Steam announcement said the changes were already live.

faq.question: Did the November 17 notes publish the Jail Time caps?
faq.answer: Kefir announced daily and overall limits without giving numerical caps or a reset time.

faq.question: Did the November 13 Q&A add weapon repair?
faq.answer: Kefir described weapon repair as a planned feature in that Q&A. The November 17 notes list no weapon repair change.

faq.question: Where can I read original ROB RUN patch notes?
faq.answer: Use the dated Steam announcement linked at the top of this page. For earlier posts, use the Steam links under the timeline. The announcement date tells you when Kefir posted the note, while the source check date tells you when this guide was reviewed.

faq.question: Did the November patch change how long a state lasts?
faq.answer: The November 17 announcement covers Jail Time limits, region progress, voice access, menus and connection changes. It does not announce a new state cycle length. Check the lifetime shown for your state when planning around a Federal Raid.

title: ROB RUN Jail Time: Limits, Prison and Progression
description: How Jail Time works in ROB RUN, what the daily and overall limits mean, how to check Shipments unlocks, and what carries over after a Federal Raid.

hero.heading: ROB RUN Jail Time Explained
hero.lead: Accumulated Jail Time carries forward after a Federal Raid and helps unlock some Shipments. On November 17, Kefir confirmed daily and overall Jail Time limits. The announcement gives no numerical caps, reset hour or formula.

source.label: Kefir’s November 17 patch notes on Steam

sections.heading: How Jail Time works in ROB RUN
sections.intro: The accumulated Jail Time value is part of long-term progression. Kefir says the Federal Raid preserves the years you already earned and converts wiped state property into Jail Time and Authority. Some Shipments use accumulated Jail Time as an unlock requirement.

table.caption: Jail Time rules and where they apply
rows: Back in Prison after a raid
Kefir says your accumulated Jail Time carries forward. A figure shown in years provides no published conversion to a real-world wait.
Look at its Shipments requirement. Some items require accumulated Jail Time. Others require a base in a settlement of a certain level.
The update confirms daily and overall limits. Kefir has yet to publish the thresholds, the reset schedule or a list of which sources count toward each.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: What is the Federal Raid?
Kefir Help Center: How do I unlock new goods?
Kefir Help Center: Why surrender to the cops?

subsections.heading: Prison and your accumulated years
paragraphs: If you end up in Prison, read the prompts for the next action available to your character. Your accumulated years are useful when checking progression and unlocks. Treat a real-world countdown as a separate question. Kefir’s public documentation gives no conversion from the number of displayed years to minutes spent in the prison area.

For example, seeing a larger Jail Time number after a server wipe is consistent with the documented conversion of state property. If the same screen also asks you to act before entering a new state, read that instruction separately. The years can carry forward even as you start over with fresh state property.

subsections.heading: Police surrender and the Federal Raid
paragraphs: Kefir’s police guide says that surrendering to a cop can cost the contents of your bag while letting you keep equipped gear. An accepted bribe can let you keep your loot. Those are outcomes of the immediate encounter. Use the Federal Raid mechanics guide for the separate end-of-cycle rules on cash, bases and long-term progression.

Record the event in plain language if you are tracking a change in Jail Time. A police encounter, a return to Prison during a server change and the end of a state’s cycle give support different starting points. Watching one incident tells you how that incident appeared on your client, while a repeatable progression formula would require more evidence.

sections.heading: What the daily and overall Jail Time limits mean
sections.intro: Kefir announced both types of limit in the November 17 update. Read the November 17 patch breakdown for the wording and use the number displayed in your current client when checking your own progress.

subsections.heading: If your Jail Time stops increasing
paragraphs: Write down the displayed total and the last event you expected to affect it. Include the approximate time and the state you were playing on. If several things happened at once, such as a disconnect during a transition, record the order. This makes a useful report even when you cannot tell whether the change is intentional.

The public announcement gives no numbers for either cap and no daily reset hour. A total that has stayed still through one session cannot tell you which limit applied, or even whether you encountered a limit. A screenshot of an old total is useful evidence about that account at that moment, rather than a measurement of the live limit for every player.

subsections.heading: Before you change plans to chase more Jail Time
paragraphs: Check the item you want in Shipments. A requirement based on settlement level may matter more to that goal than another Jail Time gain. Where progress is a concern, compare an earlier and a current total from the same character. If you are looking at a friend’s progress or at pre-patch footage, keep those numbers separate.

After a wipe, track your existing Jail Time and the Authority the client displays as separate values. The official wipe FAQ establishes carryover for accumulated Jail Time and describes the conversion into both types of progression. It does not publish a separate schedule of gains by asset or say how the new limits apply to each case.

sections.heading: Check Shipments unlocks and report missing progress

subsections.heading: Read the requirement on the specific item
paragraphs: Press H or open Shipments from the side menu in the desert, at Lenny’s Motel or in Looty Bay. The November 17 patch also added access through Lenny’s context menu. Inspect the item before you spend resources on a plot or plan a session around a progression goal.

Compare the requirement against the progress it actually names. For a settlement requirement, check where your base is and the settlement’s level. For an accumulated Jail Time requirement, compare the threshold to your displayed total. Checking the specific item also gives you a concrete way to tell whether an apparent problem is limited to one unlock.

subsections.heading: Send a useful report if the total looks wrong
paragraphs: If previously earned progress is missing, check for a wipe and verify the Steam account. Press Esc and copy the UID under your character name. To the details Kefir asks for, add your before and after totals, the state, the event that preceded the change and the unlock you were checking.

If you only noticed the issue while browsing a Shipment, include the exact item name and what its requirement showed. If you saw it after switching or after a raid, include the old and new state when you can. That lets support distinguish an item requirement from an unexpected progression change.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: I lost my progress
Kefir Help Center: Where to find your UID

faq.question: What is the daily Jail Time limit in ROB RUN?
faq.answer: The November 17 notes confirm a daily limit and an overall limit. Kefir did not publish either number or a daily reset hour in that announcement.

faq.question: Does a Federal Raid erase my accumulated Jail Time?
faq.answer: Kefir lists previously accumulated Jail Time among the progress that carries over. The same help article says wiped server property is converted into Jail Time and Authority.

faq.question: Can I tell when I will leave Prison from the number of years?
faq.answer: Kefir’s public rules do not give a conversion from the displayed years to minutes or hours. Use the instructions shown in Prison to see your next action.

faq.question: Does every Shipment unlock when I gain Jail Time?
faq.answer: Check each item’s entry in Shipments. Kefir documents some unlocks based on accumulated Jail Time and others based on having a base in a settlement of a particular level. Meeting one kind of requirement does not establish that you meet the other.

faq.question: Where do I check the latest change to Jail Time?
faq.answer: Start with Kefir’s November 17 Steam notes for the introduction of both limits. Use the client for your character’s current total and item requirements. Older progression videos may use rules that were recorded before the limits were announced.

title: ROB RUN Federal Raid: What You Lose and Keep
description: See what a ROB RUN Federal Raid takes, what you keep, how cash becomes Jail Time and Authority, and what to check before and after a state reset.

hero.heading: ROB RUN Federal Raid Guide
hero.lead: A Federal Raid resets property on a state that has reached the end of its cycle. Kefir says the game takes plots, bases, weapons and cash and converts wiped progress into Jail Time and Authority. Your existing Jail Time, cosmetics, name, tutorial progress and settings carry forward.

source.label: Kefir Help Center: What is the Federal Raid?

sections.heading: What you lose and keep in a ROB RUN Federal Raid
sections.intro: The raid applies to the state whose cycle has ended. Before it happens, take stock of your state property and record the progress Kefir lists as persistent.

table.caption: How to account for assets after a Federal Raid
rows: Reset with the state. Plan on securing land again for your next build.
Reset with state property. A weapon’s condition or where you last used it does not change the published wipe rule.
The reset includes cash. Banking protects funds against theft during the current cycle, and that protection ends at the wipe.
Carries forward. The raid converts wiped property into Jail Time and Authority. Kefir’s public guidance gives no item-by-item conversion rate.
Cosmetics and your player name carry forward. Kefir also lists tutorial progress and settings as persistent.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: Can my money be stolen?

sections.heading: How to read the asset and progression rules

subsections.heading: Treat banked money as part of the current state
paragraphs: Money in the bank has value while you are still playing the current cycle. If you plan to use it for a base project or another purchase, compare the time left in the state with the time you need to get use out of that purchase. Moving cash out of a bag for safekeeping addresses the risk of theft before the raid.

Kefir’s wipe FAQ says cash resets. Its banking guidance says protection lasts until the next wipe. Keep a record of your closing balance if you want to understand what happened later. The balance alone will not let you calculate how many years or how much Authority should appear.

subsections.heading: Check progression and ownership separately
paragraphs: Kefir identifies cosmetics, player name, tutorial progress, settings and accumulated Jail Time as carryover. A plot or building belongs in the state-property column of your checklist. If you return with the same character and see a missing building, look up the state and its lifetime before treating that loss as a missing account unlock.

The point of checking Jail Time and Authority separately is to compare what the game actually shows for each. The help article identifies both as results of the conversion and explicitly lists accumulated Jail Time among the carryover items. For how those years relate to item unlocks, see the Jail Time progression guide.

sections.heading: Before and after a Federal Raid

subsections.heading: Before the reset: record the state and pick an achievable goal
paragraphs: Write down your state ID and take a screenshot of the accumulated Jail Time you can see. If the state is near the end of its cycle, decide whether you can finish the activity before the reset. For example, a crew may be able to use a stockpile for one last session even when a new base project would make little sense.

If timing is the reason for your visit, use the state-specific wipe schedule and confirm the lifetime in your game. Compare the exact state ID before coordinating with friends. People in the same region can be on different states with different amounts of time left.

subsections.heading: After the reset: identify expected losses and missing progress
paragraphs: Confirm the Steam account and check whether the old state reached its wipe. Use the property table above to sort the missing items. A missing plot and weapons fit the reset rule. A cosmetic you already owned belongs on the list of things to check against the account and the carryover guidance.

If you find an unexpected loss, capture what was missing, your player name and the approximate time. Open Esc and copy the UID shown under the name. Tell support what documentation says should have carried over, and attach a before screenshot if you have one. A report about a specific missing cosmetic or Jail Time total gives support a clearer starting point.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: I lost my progress
Kefir Help Center: Where to find your UID

sections.heading: Tell a Federal Raid apart from other losses
paragraphs: A missing item can follow several different events. Check what happened just before you saw the loss: the state ended, you were raided by players, you picked a fresh state, or you confirmed a move to another server. These cases have different rules, so identify the event before applying the wipe table.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: How player base raids work

table.caption: Which event explains what you saw?
rows: Did your old state reach the end of its cycle? Compare wiped state property and the progress Kefir lists as persistent.
Check the particular building and its Security System. Kefir says rivals can use a decoder to obtain temporary access.
Check the state ID on the opening notice. An opening refers to a new world on the list.
Review the destination and any surrender or state-change warning you confirmed.
Find the exact error or service notice and compare it with your old state’s lifetime.

subsections.heading: If only your base was hit
paragraphs: A player raid has a target building. Kefir says the owner can repair the Security System and shut the intruder out. That is a useful check when your state is still active and the problem concerns one building. The Federal Raid rules apply when the state’s cycle ends.

subsections.heading: If you moved to join a friend
paragraphs: Compare your old and new state IDs, then consider the warning shown when you moved. The party invite and server-change guide covers the choice of destination and when to resend the invite. Return to the raid carryover list when the old state actually reached its reset.

faq.question: Does banking cash protect it from the Federal Raid?
faq.answer: Banking protects cash from other players stealing it during the cycle. Kefir says cash is wiped by the Federal Raid and describes the bank’s protection as lasting until the next wipe.

faq.question: Why do I have more Jail Time after the raid?
faq.answer: Kefir says wiped world progress is converted into Jail Time and Authority. Any Jail Time already accumulated is listed separately as progress that carries forward.

faq.question: Is this the same as another player raiding my base?
faq.answer: A Federal Raid resets the state at the end of its cycle. In a player raid, rivals target a particular base and can use a decoder on that building’s security system.

faq.question: Do I have to rebuild my base after the Federal Raid?
faq.answer: Yes. The wipe resets plots and bases. Plan to secure land again in the state where you start your next run. Keep a record of long-term progress separately from your building or equipment list.

faq.question: Do the wipe rules guarantee Battle Pass progress when I change regions?
faq.answer: The Federal Raid FAQ describes the state reset. Kefir addressed region transfers in the November 17 patch notes and explicitly said Battle Pass points carry over when you switch regions.

title: ROB RUN Change Region: Transfer & Battle Pass Progress
description: How to change region in ROB RUN from Prison, compare EU and East US ping, keep track of Battle Pass points, and distinguish a region from a friend's state.

hero.heading: How to Change Region in ROB RUN
hero.lead: From Prison, open Settings, then Other, and use the Region row to open the selector. A region is a group of servers such as EU or East US, and a state is one server within that group. Kefir’s November 17 update says your Battle Pass points carry over when switching regions.

source.label: Kefir’s November 17 patch notes on Steam

sections.heading: How to change region from Prison
sections.intro: Use the ROB RUN Change Region dialog to move between geographic server groups. The November PC client displayed Europe and North America as the two options. Kefir’s server schedule describes those groups as EU and East US.

steps.heading: Open Other in Settings
steps.description: Once you are in Prison, press Esc to open Settings. Look in the Other tab for the Region row and its current value.

steps.heading: Open Change Region
steps.description: Choose Go beside Region. Compare the listed destinations and their ping. Ask for your friend’s region first if the purpose is to play together.

steps.heading: Review and confirm
steps.description: Select the intended region and read the game’s confirmation. After the change, check your selected region and then look for the intended state.

sections.heading: Region transfer or server change?

table.caption: Which choice solves your problem?
rows: Choose a different geographic server group. Compare ping or use the group where your friends play.
Choose a specific instance within the group. Ask your friend for their exact state ID when an invite says they are on another server.
Verify that you are signed into the account that owns the progress you expect to see.
Send a fresh invite after everyone has confirmed the same state.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: Inviting a friend on another server

subsections.heading: Both players are in the same region
paragraphs: A friend can be in the same region and still on a different state. Ask for the exact state ID and compare it with your own. If the invite specifically says the friend is on another server, Kefir’s documented route uses Prison and then selects the friend’s state. Follow the ROB RUN server-switching guide for the state move and its confirmation.

subsections.heading: Your friend is in a different region
paragraphs: Agree on the destination before anyone surrenders. First locate the region where your friend is playing, then verify the exact state you want to join within that region. If one player already has a developed base and the other has just started, read the current warnings together and decide who is in a better position to move.

Once the move is complete, ask both players to read back the state ID before resending the invite. Comparing the IDs helps you diagnose an invite failure even when both players selected Europe or both selected North America.

subsections.heading: Decide which ping matters
paragraphs: If you usually play solo, compare the two ping values shown in the selector. Ping measures latency to the region, while your exact state determines who shares your server. If a group wants to play together, ask everyone to check their readings and agree on a region and state before someone leaves an established game.

subsections.heading: If you cannot access the Region row
paragraphs: Check whether your character is in Prison and whether you are looking in the Other tab. If you cannot reach the game at all, record where it stops and any displayed code. The ROB RUN connection and server status guide helps distinguish a startup or regional service problem from a menu that is unavailable during play.

inlineLinks.label: ROB RUN connection and server status guide

sections.heading: Battle Pass progress and what to check after switching

table.caption: Progress to check before confirming a region change
rows: Kefir explicitly confirms carryover. Note your total in the old region so you can compare after switching.
The Steam note specifies Battle Pass points. Record the exact reward or balance name if something else changes.
Cash, gear, plots and stored property
The patch refers to progress in general and gives no itemized transfer list. Read the current game prompt before moving with assets you want to keep.

paragraphs: Kefir’s November 17 announcement specifically confirms cross-region Battle Pass points. Use the November 17 ROB RUN patch breakdown if you are comparing a pre-patch guide with the current rule. Keep your points, individual rewards and server property as separate checks when you read what the announcement covers.

sources.label: Kefir Help Center: I lost my progress
Kefir Help Center: Where to find your UID
Kefir Help Center: ROB RUN error codes

subsections.heading: Save a before-and-after check
paragraphs: Record the current region, Steam account and Battle Pass points before confirming the move. When you reach the destination, open the same pass and compare the same number. If you were looking at a reward or tier when you last checked, also find the actual points balance so you can report the right value.

Keep any in-game warning about property or progress. The November 17 post gives no separate carryover rules for an inventory, bank balance, land or vehicle. If the client shows a warning about something you plan to keep, stop at the confirmation until you understand its scope.

subsections.heading: If points still appear missing
paragraphs: Start with the Steam account and destination region. If you also entered a different state, record both state IDs. Write down the old points, the new points, the time of the change and whether the difference appeared before or after joining the destination state.

Kefir asks for the UID, character name and approximate time for unexpected progress loss. Press Esc and copy the UID shown under the character name. If the game instead reports E-0301 or E-0302, Kefir’s error article directs you to restart Steam and update the client before retrying.

faq.question: Can I change region without switching to my friend’s specific state?
faq.answer: The region selector chooses a geographic group. When your goal is to join a friend, also check their exact state ID and use the state selection flow.

faq.question: Does my Battle Pass reset when I change region?
faq.answer: Kefir’s November 17 Steam notes say Battle Pass points carry over between regions. The notes give no separate rules for individual rewards or inventory items.

faq.question: Where can I look if the Region option is unavailable?
faq.answer: Check the Other tab in Settings while you are in Prison. If you are moving to join friends, confirm the state and region they are in before surrendering.

faq.question: Which region should I pick if I want to play with friends?
faq.answer: Pick the region your friends agree to play in and then find their exact state. A lower ping can help choose between regional groups when everyone has the option to move.

faq.question: Can a region change move my base or cash?
faq.answer: Kefir’s patch confirms Battle Pass points and supplies no item-by-item transfer list for assets. Read the current in-game prompt for your move and save any warning involving property you intend to keep.
